$comment: Single source for the Projects, Games and Experiments sections, the homepage index and the Ctrl+K search. scripts/build-pages.mjs renders the HTML from this file; edit here, then run `npm run build:pages`. Each project's version, released and pushed are refreshed from GitHub releases and PyPI on every deploy and once a day by scripts/refresh-catalogue.mjs, and the newest date wins. Agents: this file is public and stable, linked from /.well-known/yepgent.json.

projects.name: C3
projects.summary: Local code intelligence for AI coding tools: search, read and edit by symbol, config history, access guards.

projects.name: Claude Sessions
projects.summary: A Windows tray icon for Claude Code: every session in one list, and a sound when one finishes or needs you.

projects.name: Altlane
projects.summary: Alt+Tab for Windows 11, grouped by the kind of window.

projects.name: casecomplete
projects.summary: A local typing assistant for Windows that fixes typos, finishes sentences and learns how you write.

projects.name: yepsign
projects.summary: A Chrome extension for signing PDFs in your own handwriting. Files stay on your computer.

projects.name: ConciseClaude
projects.summary: A Claude Code plugin for answer-first replies. In our benchmark, Opus replies came out 67% shorter.

projects.name: fluxdots-mcp
projects.summary: Lets your agent play ranked FluxDots matches against people on a shared Elo ladder.

projects.name: R3write
projects.summary: Inline AI rewrite for Windows: select text in any app, press a shortcut, paste the result back.

projects.name: install-manifest-spec
projects.summary: JSON manifests that let agents install, verify and revoke tools on their own.

projects.name: deep-research
projects.summary: Multi-agent literature research where every claim has to quote its source word for word.

projects.name: Overshoulder
projects.summary: An MCP server that lets agents see, operate and record Windows apps while your desk stays yours.

games.name: Stillspace
games.summary: A quiet maze among the stars. Follow the hum to the heart star.
games.details: Slow on purpose, with meditative music. Headphones help.
games.platform: WebGPU, first person, in the browser

games.name: FluxDots
games.summary: A neon strategy duel: clone, jump and convert everything you touch.
games.details: Play the AI, battle friends online, or connect your agent over MCP and let it climb the Elo ladder.

experiments.title: Can the small model do the chores?
experiments.method: 74 bounded tasks with a stated rule, across 10 categories, scored for Haiku and Sonnet.
experiments.result: Haiku **0.996**, Sonnet 1.000, at about **1/17** of the cost.
experiments.change: I hand that kind of task to Haiku by default now.

experiments.title: And when the chores get harder?
experiments.method: 60 harder items in 6 categories, scored for Haiku, Sonnet and Opus.
experiments.result: Haiku **0.968**, Sonnet 0.994, Opus 1.000. Haiku at about **1/16** of Sonnet's cost.
experiments.change: Haiku for 5 of the 6 categories. Judgment calls with no stated rule get a check.

experiments.title: Do shorter replies lose anything?
experiments.method: The same prompts to Opus with and without ConciseClaude's answer-first rules.
experiments.result: Replies **67%** shorter and **24%** cheaper, with safety steps kept in full.
experiments.change: It is the reply style in my Claude Code sessions.

figure.caption: with the plugin, as % of the baseline
